# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU backend and new APIs**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 dev adds the Graphite GPU backend, async ReadPixels, and a new Vulkan.Silk.NET integration package. The new Graphite rendering engine (Vulkan, Metal, Dawn) is now bindable via SkiaSharp. A backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API covers both Ganesh and Graphite surfaces. Nano Server gains FreeType font support, and SKData.SaveTo avoids a double buffer copy.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m151 upstream stability fixes** — Multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges were applied to the Skia submodule, keeping the bundled engine current with Google's stable branch. ([#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — New bindings expose the Skia Graphite rendering engine for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn backends, providing an alternative to the Ganesh path for hardware-accelerated rendering. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels** — SKImage and SKSurface gain RequestReadPixels, an async API that works across both Ganesh and Graphite GPU backends for reading pixel data back from GPU surfaces. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET integration package** — A new NuGet package bridges SkiaSharp's Vulkan surface types with Silk.NET's Vulkan bindings, making it straightforward to integrate SkiaSharp into Silk.NET-based applications. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Binding generation is now deterministic across platforms** — The C# binding generator produces byte-for-byte identical output regardless of which OS runs it, eliminating spurious diffs in generated files when contributors work on different platforms. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## Bug Fixes

- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create failure path** — When SKImage.Create raster failed (e.g. invalid info), the CoTaskMem-allocated pixel buffer was not freed. The buffer is now correctly released on all error paths. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKData.SaveTo avoids double buffer copy** — The SaveTo path previously copied data into a managed byte array and then wrote it; it now writes directly from the native buffer, halving memory traffic for large blobs. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **GetEncodedText and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms allocation reductions** — GetEncodedText no longer allocates an intermediate string on the null-terminated fast path. SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its uniform lookup map to the known count, eliminating rehashing. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **FreeType font support on Windows Nano Server** — SkiaSharp now uses FreeType for font rendering on Nano Server, where no system font stack is available, unblocking text output in containerized Windows workloads. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Containerized test coverage: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server** — CI now validates SkiaSharp on Azure Linux, Alpine Linux (musl libc), and Windows Nano Server containers, extending the verified platform matrix. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **Windows native builds: MSVC environment initialized once per build** — The MSVC toolchain environment is now set up once at the start of each native build rather than per-target, fixing intermittent failures and reducing build time. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))
